feed.title: Kathryn Hopkins — Data, in context
feed.subtitle: New reports and research publications by Kathryn Hopkins.

entry.title: Asylum in perspective
entry.summary: A global look at asylum applications, decisions and unresolved caseloads—with country comparisons, interactive exploration and clear notes on what the data can tell us.

entry.title: Predictive Analytics
entry.summary: Explore modelled probabilities for asylum decision outcomes by origin, country of asylum and year. An interactive companion using historical UNHCR data.

entry.title: Sexual violence in perspective
entry.summary: Worldwide evidence, a detailed UK view, and the differences behind the rates—using WHO, UNICEF and UK survey data to compare what the figures actually measure.

entry.title: SpaceX Falcon 9 landing prediction
entry.summary: Can launch data help predict first-stage recovery? Explore landing trends, launch-site patterns and four tuned classifiers across 90 Falcon 9 launches.

entry.title: The affordability squeeze
entry.summary: House prices still take years of local earnings to reach. Explore how ratios changed across 318 areas from 1997 to 2025 and where costs remain furthest out of reach.

entry.title: Where the UK plugs in
entry.summary: Explore how public EV charger provision varies by region, power and local authority, using the latest Department for Transport data.
